summary: Hold: the listed tenant controls are documented, but Microsoft has not confirmed that they govern the planned GitHub integration for generative pages. The briefing also carries over billing, account and data-handling details from the separate canvas authoring agent without evidence that they apply here.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls: first row and following paragraph
claims.claim: The tenant GitHub coauthoring control is under Power Platform admin center > Manage > Tenant settings > Agentic coauthoring in Power Apps using GitHub (preview).
claims.quote:
In the Power Platform Admin Center, go to Manage > Tenant Settings.
2. Locate the setting for Agentic Coauthoring in Power Apps using GitHub.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no automation property or equivalent call for the GitHub coauthoring tenant toggle.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agentic coauthoring" "GitHub" "PowerShell"; Set-TenantSettings pac admin update-tenant-settings Copilot preview GitHub agentic coauthoring property. Opened canvas-authoring-agent, tenant-settings and list-tenantsettings; no GitHub toggle property found.

claims.claim: The GitHub coauthoring tenant toggle is a control for this generative-page integration.
claims.quote: Searched: generative pages GitHub models admin disable tenant settings PowerShell GitHub credits data processing; "generative pages" "GitHub" "tenant" "enable". Opened generative-pages, canvas-authoring-agent and tenant-settings; the toggle is documented for canvas studio.
claims.fix: Add a note to controls[0] and its rendered row: 'Controls GitHub connections for the canvas studio authoring agent (preview); Microsoft has not confirmed that it governs generative pages.' Replace 'closest tenant control' with that qualified description. See https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/tenant-settings.

claims.claim: The tenant Copilot preview control is at Power Platform admin center > Settings > Tenant settings > Copilot in Power Apps (preview).
claims.quote:
In the navigation pane, select Settings to open the Tenant settings page.
3. Select Copilot in Power Apps (preview), and then set the toggle to Off.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no equivalent automation call for the tenant-wide Copilot preview control shown here.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot in Power Apps" "PowerShell" tenant disable preview settings. Opened ai-overview and list-tenantsettings. The latter documents intelligence.disableCopilot for how-to answers, not as the equivalent of the tenant-wide preview switch.

claims.claim: The Copilot preview tenant setting governs this generative-page GitHub integration.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" "GitHub" "disable"; "Copilot in Power Apps" "PowerShell" tenant disable preview settings. Opened ai-overview, generative-pages and tenant-settings; none identifies the preview switch as governing this planned GA integration.
claims.fix: Add a note to controls[1] and its rendered row: 'General maker Copilot preview control; Microsoft has not confirmed that it applies to this generative-page GitHub integration, whose roadmap release phase is General Availability.'

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented a tenant switch or automation call specific to generative pages or their GitHub-hosted models.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" "GitHub" "disable"; "generative pages" "GitHub" "tenant" "enable"; generative pages GitHub models admin disable tenant settings PowerShell GitHub credits data processing. Opened generative-pages, tenant-settings and list-tenantsettings.

claims.claim: Requests routed through GitHub leave the Power Platform AI service.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps generative pages GitHub billing licensing meter prompts table schema personal account data governance. Opened generative-pages, its responsible-AI FAQ and canvas-authoring-agent; only the separate canvas agent documents its GitHub data flow.
claims.fix: Replace the asserted service boundary with: 'The roadmap introduces a GitHub connection, but Microsoft has not documented this path's processing boundaries. Verify the data flow and residency before using sensitive data.'

claims.claim: Spend for this integration moves to a personal GitHub account.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" "GitHub" "data" "billing"; "generative pages" "GitHub" "personal" "prompts". Opened generative-pages and canvas-authoring-agent. The record names maker credits but does not specify personal-account billing.
claims.fix: Replace the personal-account funding assertion with: 'The roadmap says requests consume the maker's GitHub credits. Agree who funds that usage.' Do not infer the paying account type from canvas-authoring-agent documentation.

claims.claim: An organisational GitHub account can fund usage through this integration.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" "GitHub" "data" "billing"; Power Apps generative pages GitHub billing licensing meter prompts table schema personal account data governance. Opened generative-pages and canvas-authoring-agent; organisation billing is not stated for this integration.
claims.fix: Remove 'or organisational' from the funding assertion and retain only the roadmap's statement that requests consume the maker's GitHub credits. Add the supported paying-account arrangements to Open questions.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Prompts are sent to GitHub for processing through this generative-page integration.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" "GitHub" "personal" "prompts"; "generative pages" "GitHub" "data" "billing". Opened generative-pages, its responsible-AI FAQ and canvas-authoring-agent; the prompt-transfer notice describes the canvas authoring agent.
claims.fix: Replace the asserted prompt transfer, including in the risk rationale, with: 'Microsoft has not documented which inputs this generative-page connection sends to GitHub; verify the data flow before using sensitive data.'

claims.claim: Table schema may be processed by GitHub through this integration.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps generative pages GitHub billing licensing meter prompts table schema personal account data governance. Opened generative-pages, its responsible-AI FAQ and canvas-authoring-agent; no source specifies schema transfer for this connection.
claims.fix: Remove table schema from the list of transmitted inputs. Ask which data and metadata are sent through the connection instead of presenting a specific payload as established.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Page content or context is sent to GitHub through this integration.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" "GitHub" "personal" "prompts"; Power Apps generative pages GitHub billing licensing meter prompts table schema personal account data governance. Opened generative-pages, its responsible-AI FAQ and canvas-authoring-agent.
claims.fix: Remove the assertion that page content or context is transferred. State that the payload and processing locations for the generative-page GitHub path are not yet documented.

claims.claim: GitHub's model providers may process the generative-page inputs.
claims.quote: Searched: generative pages GitHub models admin disable tenant settings PowerShell GitHub credits data processing; "generative pages" "GitHub" "data" "billing". Opened generative-pages, its responsible-AI FAQ and canvas-authoring-agent; no provider data-flow statement found.
claims.fix: Replace 'GitHub and its model providers' with an open question about which services and providers process data, rather than asserting a provider chain.

claims.claim: A maker links a personal GitHub account to a work tenant.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" "GitHub" "personal" "prompts". Opened generative-pages and canvas-authoring-agent. The roadmap says 'your GitHub account' but does not establish personal-account requirements or a tenant-level account linkage.
claims.fix: Use: 'The roadmap requires a maker to connect a GitHub account. Confirm supported account types, ownership and disconnection behaviour before rollout.'

claims.claim: Model availability may change without notice.
claims.quote: Searched: generative pages GitHub models admin disable tenant settings PowerShell GitHub credits data processing. Opened generative-pages and canvas-authoring-agent. The roadmap says availability 'may evolve over time', not that changes occur without notice.
claims.fix: Delete 'without notice'; use the roadmap's wording: 'Model availability through GitHub may evolve over time.'

claims.claim: GitHub, rather than Microsoft, bills usage of this generative-page model-access path.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" "GitHub" "data" "billing"; Power Apps generative pages GitHub billing licensing meter prompts table schema personal account data governance. Opened generative-pages and canvas-authoring-agent; explicit GitHub billing describes canvas authoring only.
claims.fix: Remove 'Billing is with GitHub' and 'billed by GitHub rather than Microsoft'. Retain: 'The roadmap says requests consume the maker's GitHub credits.' Add that detailed billing arrangements for this path are not yet published.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a Power Platform meter specifically for the GitHub generative-page path.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" "GitHub" "meter"; Power Apps generative pages GitHub billing licensing meter prompts table schema personal account data governance. Opened generative-pages; read licensing overview search excerpts. No meter for this specific path was documented.

claims.claim: The maker's GitHub connection sits outside Power Platform data governance.
claims.quote: Searched: GitHub organization policies Power Apps generative pages models Power Platform data governance. Opened generative-pages and canvas-authoring-agent; read Data policies and Data storage and governance search excerpts. No source establishes this blanket governance exclusion.
